scan.title: My Body
scan.subtitle: Find the right information!
sentences: Hi! I am Lily.
I have got one head and one face.
I have got two eyes and two ears.
My hair is long and blonde.
I have got one nose and one mouth.
I have got two arms and two hands.
I have got two legs.
My body is great!
translations: Bir başım ve bir yüzüm var.
İki gözüm ve iki kulağım var.
Bir burnum ve bir ağzım var.
İki kolum ve iki elim var.

skim.title: My Favourite Clothes
skim.subtitle: Read quickly and find the main idea!
sentences: Today is my birthday!
I have got new clothes.
I have got a pink dress.
My shoes are white.
Max has got a blue t-shirt.
His trousers are brown.
Mr Green has got a green jacket.
We all look great today!
translations: Mr Green'in yeşil bir ceketi var.

int.title: What's the Weather Like?
int.subtitle: Read carefully and answer the questions!
sentences: Today is Monday.
It is cold and rainy.
Lily has got a coat and an umbrella.
Max has got a hat and a scarf.
It is snowing on Tuesday.
Mr Green has got a big jacket.
On Wednesday it is hot and sunny.
Lily has got a t-shirt and a dress.
Everyone loves sunny days!
translations: Lily'nin bir paltosu ve şemsiyesi var.
Max'in bir şapkası ve atkısı var.
Mr Green'in büyük bir ceketi var.
Çarşamba günü hava sıcak ve güneşli.
Lily'nin bir tişörtü ve elbisesi var.

inf.title: Happy Birthday, Lily!
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the answer!
sentences: Today is a special day.
Lily is seven years old today.
There is a big cake on the table.
Max has got a gift for Lily.
Lily is smiling and very happy.
Mr Green says: "Happy birthday, Lily!"
Mrs Brown has got balloons.
Everyone is together.
What a great day!
translations: Max'in Lily için bir hediyesi var.
Mr Green diyor ki: "İyi ki doğdun, Lily!"
